sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Removes T-Life's access to your location while it is closed or in the background.
Stops T-Life from scanning for Bluetooth devices and beacons, and hides your paired devices.
Stops Radar, which sends your location to its servers every 30 seconds.
Stops Quantum Metric, which records what you do in T-Life.
Turns off the T-Life AI assistant.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of your network from T-Life.
